sql: SELECT (AVG(CASE WHEN invoice_date >= DATE '2025-01-01' AND invoice_date < DATE '2026-01-01' THEN total END) - AVG(CASE WHEN invoice_date >= DATE '2024-01-01' AND invoice_date < DATE '2025-01-01' THEN total END)) / NULLIF(AVG(CASE WHEN invoice_date >= DATE '2024-01-01' AND invoice_date < DATE '2025-01-01' THEN total END), 0) AS yoy_growth_rate FROM public.invoice;
